acceptanceCriteria: All four current GitHub Actions jobs use exactly ubuntu-24.04.
The CI regression test fails when any workflow contains ubuntu-latest or a non-pinned runs-on value, and passes for the repository workflows.
cargo fmt, cargo clippy -D warnings, cargo test --locked --all, and Runtime verification provide fresh evidence.
The obsolete codex/wi-production-provider-e2e-cadence local and remote refs are removed only after a recoverable bundle and exact-ref checks; origin/data remains.
goal: Make CI runner selection deterministic against the Ubuntu 26.04 rollout and leave no stale cadence work branch, with evidence-backed verification and preserved recovery history.
intent: Pin GitHub Actions Rust and system-tool jobs to ubuntu-24.04 and add a CI regression guard that rejects ubuntu-latest; clean the obsolete local and remote cadence work branch while preserving the dedicated data archive branch and PR history.
sources: origin/data is the Weekly Radar archive branch
